privileged_info_for_vlm: The ground station 'Miami_NHC' must be set to Latitude 25.7543, Longitude -80.3823 (West is negative in GPredict), and Altitude 2m. The NORAD IDs for verification are: GOES 16 (41866), GOES 18 (51850), METEOSAT 11 (40732) for the GEO_WX Map module; and NOAA 19 (33591), METOP-C (43689), SUOMI NPP (37849) for the LEO_WX Polar module.
